<thought>To propose a single-step retrosynthesis, I need a template that corresponds to the reverse of a carbonyl‑ene reaction: breaking the newly formed C–O (alcohol) and C–C bonds and re‑forming a carbonyl (C=O) and an alkene (C=C). I’ll search the template catalog for reactions that break a hydroxyl group and form a ketone, with the appropriate bond changes.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["hydroxyl"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-C"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C=O", "C=C"],
  "limit": 5
}​</action_input>
